state_limits: Child HEAD equals parent pin; git status --short --untracked-files=all was empty. No config, credentials, provider endpoints, network calls or generated output were inspected.
description: A Python script that merges model metadata from LiteLLM catalogs, provider endpoints, account catalogs, vendor documentation and local assertions into a LiteLLM YAML configuration.
scope_audience: A local configuration-generation utility for a user maintaining model/provider rosters; output paths and source inputs are currently environment-specific constants.

creativity.reason: Per-field source precedence and roster-versus-annotation separation are an interesting integration design, though overall novelty is unknown.

current_usefulness.reason: The source contains typed fact/doc schemas and a multi-source generator, but local absolute paths, credentials and endpoint compatibility prevent safe fresh use without configuration.

expected_usefulness.reason: If completed for its stated local workflow, it can reduce manual model-config merging for one maintainer; broader audience and advantage are ungrounded.

impl_progress.reason: A substantial generator script and source-priority logic exist, but README says there is no stable CLI or test suite and execution depends on external sources.

presentability.reason: README explains sources and configuration risks, but requires hand-editing source constants and lacks a tested entry point or example output.

verification: README and generator schema/constant definitions inspected; no local config or token data accessed and no network or script execution.
contribution: The implementation encodes source-specific model facts and per-field precedence; it is a configuration integration, not an independently verified current provider catalog.
alternatives_question: Which current configuration generators already merge provider rosters and per-field metadata with source precedence, and what same-input output difference matters to the maintainer?

delivery_likelihood.reason: The README calls the local utility complete, though transfer to a new machine requires replacing paths and verifying source compatibility.

reason: Meaningful implementation supports the substantial-work route; local utility value is plausible but unverified against alternatives and fresh-environment use is weak.
next_step: On an authorized safe fixture with credentials excluded, verify generated aliases and field precedence against an independently specified expected YAML.
